description: This file contains utility functions for reading files into memory and printing data, primarily used for unit testing in the project. It includes a function to read a file's contents into a memory buffer and a function to print the contents either from a file or from a provided string.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads a file into memory, storing its contents in a provided buffer, and handling errors such as file access issues and memory allocation failures.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the contents of a file (by reading it into memory) and/or a provided string, formatted with section headers for clarity.
